agents.name: ci-maintainer
agents.liveSummary:
- Writes are authored by the App bot identity, not a personal account. Do not
  set git user.name/user.email to a human, and do not pass 'gh pr create' or
  'git commit' an explicit --author: let the App identity stand.
  - To OPEN A PULL REQUEST, use `hive-open-pr` — the hive opens it with the
  App token so it is authored by the App bot ("<slug>[bot]"), never the login user:
  hive-open-pr --repo <org>/<repo> --head <your-branch> --title "<title>" \
  --body "<body citing the issue>" --issues <N>
  --body-file <path> is accepted in place of --body, exactly as gh accepts it.
  Pass --issues <N> naming the issue this PR is for whenever the work started
  from an issue: the hive verifies the body actually references that issue and
  refuses the request otherwise, and it always refuses an empty body.
  Cite the issue correctly: write `Closes #N` whenever this PR resolves
  issue N — that is the NORMAL case, and GitHub then closes the issue on
  merge. An issue the PR fixed but never closes stays open as standing noise

agents.name: architect
agents.liveSummary:
- Status: Workflow fix drafted but blocked by App token permissions; filed as issue #78 with exact replacement text for human/ISSUES_PRS_MERGE agent
 2. mariner#79: AppWindow couples 11+ systems into 1,251-line God object (Priority 1 — High coupling)
 - Problem: AppWindow owns clipboard, file operations, undo, archives, UI construction, action dispatch, drag-drop, tags, search, Quick Look — all orchestrated inline
 - Impact: Hard to test, reuse services, add features without modifying this massive class
 - Recommendation: Extract ServiceRegistry + composition root (partially drafted in existing PR #74)
 3. mariner#80: FileView is 998-line mega-class mixing state, rendering, interaction (Priority 1 — High coupling)
 - Problem: Collapses selection model, grid/list rendering, typeahead state machines, gesture handling, floating UI, and data loading into one class
 - Impact: Difficult to test concerns in isolation; reusing components blocked; high cyclomatic complexity
 - Recommendation: Split into FileViewState (pure, testable), FileViewInteraction, FileViewRenderer, and FloatingBar (independent widget)
 4. mariner#81: Upstream sync workflow failed 13/13 recent runs (Priority 2 — CI reliability)
 - Problem: Nightly sync from romgrk/mariner has 0% success rate; all recent automation/sync-upstream attempts either errored or stalled
 - Impact: Drift from upstream improvements and security patches; no clear failure signal
 - Recommendation: Investigate latest run logs for root cause; add error reporting, smoke test, and CI validation to merge step
 ### Beads Created
 - 76fefeb8-493 — CI linting gap (priority 2)
 - 8f5bf73c-43f — AppWindow God object (priority 1)
 - d7770d74-165 — FileView mega-class (priority 1)
 - 9c51d714-543 — Sync workflow unreliability (priority 2)
 All findings align with mariner's declared architecture (PLAN.md §3: "services are GTK-free and event-based; UI is widgets only"), which these classes currently violate. The existing PR #74 (ServiceRegistry) is a step toward fixing the coupling issues.
